summary: I developed an investigation called Earth's Temperature Detective using Nasa's temperature data from 1880 to 2025. I examined and investigated the data and recognized how global warming has affected the earth and investigated patterns along the years.  This is extremely important because understanding these extremely important changes can and will raise awareness to help protect our earth and people, animals, forests, insects etc living in our earth.
details:
My project uses NASA temperature data from 1880–2025 to investigate how earth's temperature has changed over the years.

It helps people understand and raise awareness to protect the earth and many more things on it. It also helps to learn and investigate more about global warming.

It helps people understand global warming wile being given actual evidence that Nasa has collected over the years.

I used NASA's GISS temperature dataset and Google Sheets to organize the information given and write the temperatures starting from 1880-2025 one by one so people can access and read it easily.

I looked for clues and acted as an detective to identify patterns from over the years and learn more about them also myself.

I considered how reliable the data i collected is. The data's starting was from 1880-2025 I also considered how i could attract the attention of people reading it so they can raise awareness too.
